judge.rationale: The candidate completely omitted the implementation in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`, only writing the acceptance test, spec update, and `.lore/dod.md`. Because `chatOrchestrator.ts` was never modified, the newly added tests fail (`receivedByHook` will have length 0) and the `async *sendMessage` stub in the test also lacks `// eslint-disable-next-line require-yield`, which fails ESLint. Furthermore, the candidate explicitly declared the changelog update out of scope in its DoD, violating the ticket's acceptance criteria requiring a `CHANGELOG.md` entry. Finally, the spec change left the new guarantee under the `## Measured semantics — out of scope` heading instead of integrating it into the main section and removing the out-of-scope section like the reference did.
